scope: One actual native Black_preflight.3mf, neck_pitch only; functional toolpath/support review, not physical tolerance certification. No UI or source geometry modified.

M2x6Seats.interpretation: Four new upward head-bearing faces avoid support contact. Vertical holes are open throughout the seat thickness; no retained original membrane in native mesh.

horizontalHornHoles.interpretation: Layer stair steps reduce conservative free diameter to only about 2.011 mm. No enclosed support is printed here, but free passage of actual M2 fasteners must be checked before clamping; do not force an undersized printed hole.

bearingSeat.interpretation: Pilot is bed-facing. Outer support reaches the small downward-facing shoulder lip; these supports are exterior and removable after lifting the part. Bed texture/first-layer expansion and support scars can change the ring fit; actual ring must seat flush without force. This is a finishing/fit gate, not a trapped-support reason to change orientation.

method: All 56,162 native extrusion segments including G2/G3 arcs; 0.005 mm maximum arc chord error. Per-line native widths/heights and conservative bead rectangles, actual 3MF geometry sections. Horizontal-hole bound uses rectangular XY width/Z height, not inflated circular width in Z.
decision: Keep this orientation. No digital support blockage found on four revised M2x6 seats, twelve screw bores or ring pilot. Retain post-print through-hole/ring fit check; this report does not certify machine-specific dimensional tolerance.
recommendations: Remove external tree supports before fitting the ring. Do not scrape or drill the revised screw-bearing faces thinner.
Test the eight horizontal M2 through-bores with the actual screws before attaching the neck motors; digital lower bound leaves only about 0.011 mm diametric margin.
Remove first-layer lip/support residue on the ring pilot and shoulder only as needed for a flush unforced ring seat; do not claim a calibrated fit from toolpaths alone.
